text.ja: 円偏波Alfvén波：全保存変数の解析セル平均 sinc(h)=sin(pi*h)/(pi*h); theta=2*pi*(x-t); (Bybar,Bzbar)=.1*sinc(h)*(cos(theta),sin(theta)); (mybar,mzbar)=-(Bybar,Bzbar); rhobar=Bxbar=1; Ebar=.66. γ=5/3、[0,1]周期、ρ=1、p=.1、Bx=1、振幅.1、速度1、T=1、32/64/128セル。初期値と参照は保存変数の解析セル平均であり、セル平均から復元する圧力は点の定圧と区別します。横磁場と横運動量にはsinc(h)を掛け、E=.66を保ちます。独立Gauss16求積と照合します。図のx–tは1次元空間と保存時刻であり、斜め2次元伝播ではありません。
text.en: Circular Alfven wave: analytic full-state conserved cell means sinc(h)=sin(pi*h)/(pi*h); theta=2*pi*(x-t); (Bybar,Bzbar)=.1*sinc(h)*(cos(theta),sin(theta)); (mybar,mzbar)=-(Bybar,Bzbar); rhobar=Bxbar=1; Ebar=.66. gamma5/3, periodic[0,1], rho1,p.1,Bx1,amplitude.1, speed1,T1,32/64/128 cells. Initialize/reference conserved analytic cell means; pressure recovered from means differs from constant pointwise pressure. Apply sinc(h) to transverse magnetic fields and momenta, retaining E=.66, and qualify against independent Gauss16 quadrature. The x-t picture shows one spatial dimension and saved times, not oblique2D propagation.
